M-WATCH-REF.Purpose: Persistent slot watching: track a property slot itself and automatically resubscribe handlers whenever the behavior instance in the slot is replaced.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: WatchRef: slot change observation, unsubscribe-old + subscribe-new.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: One-shot binding to the current instance — owned by M-BIND-REF.

Requirements.REQ-001: Slot replacement releases the old subscription before acquiring the new one per SS-PROPERTY-REFS.REQ-001 and S-RUNTIME-PLATFORM.REQ-003.
Requirements.REQ-002: WatchRef uses strong handlers independent of owner type; rebinding follows Changed and explicit owner cleanup releases the tracked registration.

Inputs.IN-001: slot: IPropertyRef — the property slot being watched.
Inputs.IN-002: handler: Delegate — reattached on every slot change.

Outputs.OUT-001: current subscription state mirroring the live slot behavior.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Registers/releases subscriptions through M-BEHAVIOR-REGISTRY on each change.

M-WATCH-REF.Codemap: * `WatchRef` : `IPropertyRef` ref struct * `WatchRef(propertyRef)` -> slot change -> unsubscribe old + subscribe new * `WatchRef.{OnUpdate|OnActivate|OnStart|OnComplete|OnReset}` * `WatchRef` -> `BehaviorRegistry.RegisterSubscription` / `UnregisterSubscription`
